executive_summary.overview: Novafacture Global Solutions Ltd. is a fictional multinational engineering conglomerate specializing in industrial shopfloor machinery, automated modular assembly lines, and industrial telemetry edge nodes. Currently undergoing an enterprise-wide SAP S/4HANA migration paired with shopfloor MES convergence across 12 manufacturing plants.
executive_summary.strategic_trajectory: Transitioning from legacy bespoke shopfloor software towards Clean Core cloud architectures and standardized SAP BTP integration endpoints for real-time traceability and compliance telemetry.
executive_summary.top_opportunities_summary: High-priority advisory engagement for SAP-MES-OT architectural convergence and Cloud ALM governance.
executive_summary.primary_stakeholders: Dr. Marcus Vance (VP Global IT) and Elena Rostova (Director of Plant Digitalization).
